title: Phase 2 consolidation & gate
objective: PairCraft postmortem and resume bullets, the first weekly mock interview, CS + LLM revision, and the Phase 2 assessment. Step 2 exit test.
topics: Cloud checkpoint: AWS architecture design review
theory: Google project rule: README → diagram → API spec → tests → CI → deployment → metrics → benchmark → postmortem → trade-offs → demo → resume bullets.
checkpoint: Step 2 exit test: ship an LLM feature with structured outputs + retries + cost logging (done: Voice→Notes)

knowledge: Which P2 knowledge questions did you miss?
practical: Phase 2 gate pass criteria all met

tasks.text: DSA · Graphs: Course Schedule (Medium, B75) — 25-min honest attempt each, then the NeetCode video; write pattern + time/space complexity in your solutions repo; log gap type in mistakes.md.

PairCraft failure postmortem: the 3 worst bugs (sync, queue, media) — timeline, root cause, fix, prevention. docs/tradeoffs.md: for every technology, why this, alternatives, what failed, what happens at 10× scale.
Write 3–5 resume bullets: action + technology + scale + measurable result (e.g., “Built a Redis-backed job queue processing N runs/min with retries/DLQ; p95 under X ms at 200 concurrent users”).
10-min recall: explain yesterday’s “PairCraft failure postmortem: the 3 worst bugs (sync, queue, media) — timeline, root cause” aloud without notes; write one gap you found.
DSA · Graphs: Course Schedule II (Medium, B75) — 25-min honest attempt each, then the NeetCode video; write pattern + time/space complexity in your solutions repo; log gap type in mistakes.md.
Pramp mock coding interview #1 (45 min). Record. Debrief within the hour: which stage wobbled (clarify / brute force / pattern / code / test / communicate)? Log gap type.
Re-solve cold: 6 D2 problems you flagged (2 trees, 2 graphs, 1 heap, 1 backtracking).
Quiet Network: 1–2 genuine conversations with engineers from your target list (thoughtful comment or a question about their work; no pitch, no referral ask). Log in the tracker.
DSA · Graphs: Redundant Connection (Medium) — 25-min honest attempt each, then the NeetCode video; write pattern + time/space complexity in your solutions repo; log gap type in mistakes.md.
OS/DBMS/CN rapid recall: 30 questions from your notes, answered aloud without notes, then checked. Rewrite any answer you fumbled.
Implement from memory in Python: BFS, DFS (iterative + recursive), topological sort (Kahn), union-find with path compression, Dijkstra with heapq.
10-min recall: explain yesterday’s “Implement from memory in Python: BFS, DFS (iterative + recursive), topological sort (Kahn)” aloud without notes; write one gap you found.

DSA · Graphs: Number of Connected Components in an Undirected Graph (Medium, B75) — 25-min honest attempt each, then the NeetCode video; write pattern + time/space complexity in your solutions repo; log gap type in mistakes.md.
Rebuild, in one sitting, a streaming chat endpoint with one tool and a validated structured output — from an empty folder. Time it.
DSA D2 timed set: 2 unseen mediums (trees/graphs) in 45 min, narrating.
Quiet Network: 1–2 genuine conversations with engineers from your target list (thoughtful comment or a question about their work; no pitch, no referral ask). Log in the tracker.
10-min recall: explain yesterday’s “Rebuild, in one sitting, a streaming chat endpoint with one tool and a validated structure” aloud without notes; write one gap you found.
DSA · Graphs: Graph Valid Tree (Medium, B75) — 25-min honest attempt each, then the NeetCode video; write pattern + time/space complexity in your solutions repo; log gap type in mistakes.md.
Take the Phase 2 gate (Assessments → P2): knowledge, coding, practical (PairCraft beta demo from a clean browser; Voice→Notes clip), explanation. Record results.
DSA · Graphs: Word Ladder (Hard) — 25-min honest attempt each, then the NeetCode video; write pattern + time/space complexity in your solutions repo; log gap type in mistakes.md.
Passed → tick m-os, m-db, m-net, m-llm, m-dsa2; write the weekly + phase review. Failed → follow “fail → revisit” before W19.
LinkedIn build-note: PairCraft postmortem highlights. Attend/replay 100xSchool.

DevOps · GitHub Actions: matrix builds, dependency caching, reusable workflows, environments with required reviewers, OIDC federation to the cloud (no long-lived keys), artifact upload, scheduled workflows. Refactor PairCraft’s pipeline to a reusable workflow used by two repos.
Cloud architecture gate: from a blank page, design PairCraft on AWS with HA, observability, least privilege, backups and a rough monthly cost estimate.

Weekly revision — Failure postmortem + design trade-offs, Resume bullets (action + technology + scale + result), First Pramp mock (weekly from now), DSA D2 timed set + re-solves: rewrite the key ideas from memory (no notes), then compare with your notes and fix the gaps. Reimplement two things from this week without looking.
DSA spaced re-solve (from W15): Subsets (Medium, B75) · Combination Sum (Medium, B75) — cold, ≤30 min each, narrate.
Weekly review: answer this week’s knowledge questions aloud, run the practical checks, then write the three notes (struggled / learned / improve) in Weekly Plan → Review. Update the tracking sheet.

JS/MERN spaced recall (Cycle 1 · explain + implement) · Promises & error handling: Rewrite promise chaining rules from memory (return in then, catch placement, finally); implement promisify + retry-with-backoff. Log misses in mistakes.md; if you fail the check, redo the matching module in Side Tracks → 🟨 JavaScript & MERN Refresher.
Plan next week: read W19’s objective and Day 1; move any unfinished 🔴 task into next week’s Day 1; confirm calendar blocks. Then rest — consistency beats intensity.
